messages:
Maria (CS): Quick idea — build a 1-page micro-runbook customers get during onboarding surges. Focus on three practical levers customers can flip quickly: prefix caching, small-batch warmups, and streaming fallbacks. Draft below, please skim and flag anything risky.
Ben (CSM): +1. Also add a renewal-risk signal: if customer hits >20% latency SLA misses in 24h and hasn't run a warmup, flag CSM for outreach. Keep the doc customer-facing and scannable. :mag: :exclamation:
Ada (Eng): Nice. From runtime side, recommend safe defaults we can show: batch_size=8, max_latency_ms=250, kv_cache=on. Also include an example prefetch API call and a tiny SDK snippet. I'll check wording for any ops-sensitive bits.
Sam (SE): I made a short checklist we can paste into the doc: 1) Verify model pin/version, 2) Run prefetch with top 5 prefixes, 3) Start gradual warmup (batch 4 -> 8 over 15m), 4) Enable streaming fallback for long contexts, 5) Monitor token latency and error rate for 1h. Keep it action-first.
Maria (CS): Draft micro-runbook content: 

- Goal: Reduce first-week token latency and prevent bad renewal experiences during initial spikes.
- Quick wins (customer-facing):
  * Prefetch top prefixes (examples: user prompts, system templates). Safe request: POST /v1/prefetch with small payloads.
  * Warmup strategy: start with 3x small batches, then step to target batch_size over 10–20 minutes.
  * Streaming fallback: if median response >300ms, enable streaming to show progressive output.
  * Monitoring: screenshot or link to Console per-route latency + token cost.

- Recommended defaults (for handoff):
  * batch_size: 8
  * warmup_sequence: [4, 6, 8] over 15m
  * kv_cache: enabled
  * stream_on_latency_ms: 300

- Example prefetch API (customer-ready):
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefetch
{
  "model": "redwood-1-small",
  "prompts": ["Welcome message", "Support snippet", "Shop prompt"],
  "batch": 6,
  "timeout_ms": 3000
}
```

- Tiny SDK hint (JS):
```js
await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-1-small',
  batch_size: 6,
  streaming: true // fallback preserves UX
});
```

- Hand-off checklist for CSM/SE: paste the warmup commands, confirm model pin, schedule a 30-min session in week 1, and capture feedback via the quick form. Link: https://rwd.ai/cs-feedback-runbook

Ben (CSM): Suggest a one-line script customers can paste for a quick prewarm; also include a blurb for sales renewals: "If warmup not completed within 48h and traffic >50rps, flag as high touch."
Ada (Eng): Small edit: change streaming trigger to 350ms to avoid thrash on slower networks. Also add note: "Do not prefetch PII or long confidential examples; customers should send sanitized prefixes."
ops-bot: Scheduled reminder created by ops-bot: "Send micro-runbook to new customers who exceed 2k tokens/day during trial" at 2024-06-11T09:00:00Z
Sam (SE): I'll convert the checklist into a one-page PDF and add a short script block for curl. Want me to open a short feedback capture card at the bottom of the doc?
Maria (CS): Yes — Sam please draft PDF + curl snippet. Ada, can you quick-approve the wording by EOD? Ben, I'll add the renewal-risk sentences and the CSM playbook. After approvals we push to the onboarding template and add the feedback link. :rocket:
Maria (CS): Action items: Maria = finalize doc + add CSM triggers; Sam = PDF + curl snippet; Ada = approve runtime wording; Ben = finalize renewal copy. Target: ship to docs and onboarding kit by next Tue.
